positioning: Free peer-to-peer plans; monetise creator/organiser tools, convenience, local business discovery and clearly labelled sponsorships. Never charge for another person’s presence.

plans.name: Free
features: browse and create normal public plans

plans.name: Pro
features: larger group tools subject to safety limits

monetization_streams.name: Subscriptions
monetization_streams.notes: Keep free core discovery, joining and safety. Test price sensitivity via randomized cohorts.

monetization_streams.name: Sponsored activities
monetization_streams.notes: Label paid placement clearly; disclose ranking impact.

monetization_streams.name: Venue/club plans
monetization_streams.notes: Sell qualified local discovery, not guaranteed attendance.

monetization_streams.name: Event ticketing/referrals
monetization_streams.notes: Use authorised ticketing/payment partners and clear refund terms.

monetization_streams.name: Optional activity boosts
monetization_streams.notes: Never let paid boosts bypass safety, spam controls or relevance; cap per user/day.

never_gate: basic group chat needed for accepted plans
paywall_policy.do_not_trigger: Do not force a paywall immediately after the second or third meetup. Offer a value-led contextual trial after the user has experienced repeat value; keep core network free.
paywall_policy.store_billing: Digital app features and subscriptions should use Apple In-App Purchase / Google Play Billing where required by the current storefront policies.

unit_economics_examples.notes: 3% paid conversion; excludes business revenue, fees, taxes and refunds.
4% paid conversion; illustrative, not a forecast.

crore_math.note: This is gross annual recurring subscription revenue arithmetic before app-store fees, GST, refunds, churn, support, marketing and other expenses; it is not a profit estimate.
